title: Remediation Policy for Charges Standing on Auto Loans: Bank Error and Courtesy
content:
Two grounds, and only two, support taking a charge off a loan of the Auto Loans line: bank error and courtesy.

## Withdrawn basis

The basis by which a charge was taken off only ever in full, never in part, and as a single entry against the charge, is **no longer in force**. How a charge standing above the amount this charter fixes for it is put right is governed by the basis now in force for Auto Loans.

## Bank error

A bank-error waiver applies to any charge assessed contrary to this charter, such as a late charge on an installment satisfied within the state grace days, a late charge above the state ceiling or the state percentage, a late charge on an installment deferred by an extension, or a second late charge for one installment. There is no limit on bank-error waivers.

## Courtesy

A courtesy waiver applies only to a late charge. Three conditions bound it, and all three must hold.

| Condition | What it reads | Where it is read from |
|---|---|---|
| The customer's courtesy late charge waivers over the rolling 365 days, counted across all of that customer's Auto Loans, must be below the number the product publishes | a count of courtesy waivers, not of charges | the bank's record of waivers on the customer's loans |
| The installments immediately before the late one must show at least the number of consecutive on-time installments the product publishes | consecutive installments, counted backwards from the late one and stopping at the first that fails | the bank's record of payments credited to the loan |
| The loan must be active or delinquent when the courtesy waiver is granted | the standing of the loan on the day of the grant | the bank's record of the loan |

Extension fees and returned payment fees are never waived as a courtesy.

## Once only

A charge can be waived at most once. Whether a charge has already been waived is read from the bank's record of waivers, correlated to the charge itself.

## A charge that was already paid

Where a waived charge had already been paid out of an earlier payment, the waived amount is returned by applying it to principal on the date of the waiver, recorded by that same waiver entry.

## Points of judgement

The courtesy count is a customer-level count and the on-time run is a loan-level one. A customer with two Auto Loans who has already had a courtesy waiver on one of them in the last 365 days is at the product's published allowance for both, unless the product publishes a larger allowance.

An on-time run is broken by the first installment that fails, counting backwards; installments before that break do not rejoin the run.
